details.description: GPT-5 mini is OpenAI's smaller, faster and cheaper variant of GPT-5, released August 7, 2025 for well-defined, high-volume tasks that don't need the full model's depth. It takes text and image input and produces text output, supports reasoning tokens, and has a knowledge cutoff of May 31, 2024. OpenAI's own docs now suggest starting new low-latency, high-volume workloads with GPT-5.6 Terra instead, and Artificial Analysis lists GPT-5 mini (high) as deprecated, superseded by GPT-5.4 mini (xhigh).
advantages: Positioned by OpenAI for low-latency, high-volume tasks with well-defined, precise prompts (OpenAI API docs).
Supports reasoning tokens and function calling (OpenAI API docs).
Automatically serves ChatGPT's free-tier users once they reach GPT-5's usage limit, per OpenAI's GPT-5 launch announcement.
disadvantages: OpenAI's own docs recommend starting new low-latency, high-volume workloads with GPT-5.6 Terra instead.
Artificial Analysis lists GPT-5 mini (high) as deprecated, with an Intelligence Index score of 17, below GPT-5's 23.
Knowledge cutoff of May 31, 2024, earlier than GPT-5's September 30, 2024 (OpenAI API docs).
Output is text only; the model does not generate images, audio or video (OpenAI API docs).
use_cases: High-volume, low-latency chat and classification tasks with well-defined prompts.
Cost-sensitive agentic tool use with function calling.
Fallback model for ChatGPT free-tier conversations once GPT-5 usage limits are reached.

sources.title: GPT-5 mini (high) - Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis

notes: OpenAI's deprecations page schedules the gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 snapshot for shutdown Dec 11, 2026 (replacement gpt-5.6-terra), earlier than the catalog's deprecation_date fact (2027-02-09); kept the catalog's date but flagging the discrepancy. openai.com blocked direct fetches (403); the introducing-gpt-5 launch page was read via a text-extraction proxy (r.jina.ai).
